overview_description: List the integration connections on your Exsited instance, filtered by status, and read one connection.
intro: Integration connections are the integrations set up on your Exsited instance. You can list them, filtered by status, and read one by its `uuid`. This area has 2 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
notes: **Filter by status with `filter_status`.** The values are `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` and `DISCONNECTED`; any other value returns `400`.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records sit under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` to read the next page, and stop when `pagination.has_more` is `false`.
**A `limit` of `0` returns `400`.** Ask for at least one record per page.
**Read one connection by its `uuid`.** Take the `uuid` of a record in the listing and pass it as `integration_connection_id`.

endpoints.title: List integration connections
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of integration connections, which you can filter by status.
endpoints.description: Records are under `data`, and the listing pages by cursor. Filter by status with `filter_status`: `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` or `DISCONNECTED`. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of records per page. A `limit` of `0` returns `400`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` from the previous page, to read the next page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by; prefix it with `-` for descending order.

parameters.name: filter_status
parameters.description: Only connections with this status: `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` or `DISCONNECTED`. Any other value returns `400`.

200.description: One page of integration connections, under `data`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an integration connection
endpoints.description: Pass the connection's `uuid`, as the listing shows it, as `integration_connection_id`. The response is the connection's fields, with no wrapper key.

parameters.name: integration_connection_id
parameters.description: The connection's `uuid`, taken from a record in the listing.

data.description: The integration connections on this page.

has_more.description: `false` on the last page, even if `next_cursor` is set.
